report.explanation: Current telemetry does not substantiate the operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors. Traces show all checkout, order, payment, inventory and reservation spans returning 200/ok. Gateway and order metrics show 502 counts of 0 on /v1/checkout and /v1/orders. The only deployment record is baseline order v1.0.0 with no previous version, which cannot establish deployment-caused failure. Logs were excluded. Insufficient evidence to bound a root cause; hand off.
missing_evidence: Logs for order and gateway services (excluded from context) to confirm or refute checkout errors
Error-rate/latency metrics over a longer window to establish whether checkout errors actually occurred
Deployment records for gateway and payment services, not only order
Trace spans showing non-200 statuses or errors; current traces are all 200/ok
